property_summary: For any accounts[] and ids[] of equal length, C.balanceOfBatch(accounts, ids)[i] always equals C.balanceOf(accounts[i], ids[i]) for every i; the mutant replaces all ids with ids[0], so when ids contains at least two different ids and balances for those ids differ the mutant returns a different array.
change_summary: Compute each batch balance using the id at position 0 for all accounts instead of the corresponding id, making results depend only on accounts and the first id.
